title: BGP: Update dissector with current registries and RFCs
description:
The various IANA registries related to BGP have been updated over time
and the BGP dissector has not always kept pace with them. This change
tries to include most of these changes, which results in:
- Additional defines of protocol values
  All over the place
- Extension of value_strings where these values are mapped to strings
  All over the place
- Some change to and addition of flags
  Due to RFC 8665-8667, the flags have been changed/extended
- Some adaptation of code due to additional protocol values
  With the introduction of OSPFv3 NLRI protocol ID it makes sense to
  extend the code to handle both OSPF IDs the same, assuming that is
  correct (at least correcter than handling it as IS-IS)

commits_data.title: BGP: Update dissector with current registries and RFCs
commits_data.message:
BGP: Update dissector with current registries and RFCs

The various IANA registries related to BGP have been updated over time
and the BGP dissector has not always kept pace with them. This change
tries to include most of these changes, which results in:
- Additional defines of protocol values
  All over the place
- Extension of value_strings where these values are mapped to strings
  All over the place
- Some change to and addition of flags
  Due to RFC 8665-8667, the flags have been changed/extended
- Some adaptation of code due to additional protocol values
  With the introduction of OSPFv3 NLRI protocol ID it makes sense to
  extend the code to handle both OSPF IDs the same, assuming that is
  correct (at least correcter than handling it as IS-IS)
